68592-hayti-or-the-black-republic.title: The Black Republic.
68592-hayti-or-the-black-republic.creator: Sir Spenser St. John, K.C.M.G.
68592-hayti-or-the-black-republic.description: A book by Sir Spenser St. John, K.C.M.G.. When I reached Hayti in January 1863, the capital possessed several respectable public buildings. The palace, without any architectural beauty, was large and commodious, and well suited to the climate; the Senate, the House of Representatives, the dwellings occupied by several of the Ministers, the pretty little theatre, were all features which have now entirely disappeared.

arxiv-2101-09855.title: Weak Signal Asymptotics for Sequentially Randomized Experiments
arxiv-2101-09855.creator: Xu Kuang, Stefan Wager
arxiv-2101-09855.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Xu Kuang, Stefan Wager. We use the lens of weak signal asymptotics to study a class of sequentially randomized experiments, including those that arise in solving multi-armed bandit problems. In an experiment with n n time steps, we let the mean reward gaps between actions scale to the order 1 / n 1/\sqrt{n} so as to preserve the difficulty of the learning task as n n grows.

arxiv-2205-09131.title: Discrete Goldstone Bosons
arxiv-2205-09131.creator: Victor Enguita-Vileta
arxiv-2205-09131.description: Abstract Exact discrete symmetries, if non-linearly realized, can reduce the ultraviolet sensitivity of a given theory. The scalars stemming from spontaneous symmetry breaking are massive without breaking the discrete symmetry, and those masses are protected from divergent quadratic corrections. This is in contrast to non-linearly realized continuous symmetries, for which the masses of pseudo-Goldstone bosons require an explicit breaking mechanism.

In this paper, we have investigated the importance of quark charm in nuclear structure functions in the color dipole model at small x x . The charm structure function per nucleon F 2 c ​ A / A F_{2}^{cA}/A for light and heavy nuclei in a wide range of transverse separations r \mathrm{r} with renormalization and factorization scales are considered.

arxiv-2505-12271.title: Spectral moments of complex and symplectic non-Hermitian random matrices Thanks: The authors are grateful to the DFG-NRF International Research Training Group IRTG 2235 supporting the Bielefeld-Seoul graduate exchange programme (NRF-2016K2A9A2A13003815). Sung-Soo Byun was supported by the National R
arxiv-2505-12271.creator: Gernot Akemann, Sung-Soo Byun, Seungjoon Oh
arxiv-2505-12271.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Gernot Akemann, Sung-Soo Byun, Seungjoon Oh. We study non-Hermitian random matrices belonging to the symmetry classes of the complex and symplectic Ginibre ensemble, and present a unifying and systematic framework for analysing mixed spectral moments involving both holomorphic and anti-holomorphic parts. For weight functions that induce a recurrence relation of the associated planar orthogonal polynomials, we derive explicit formulas for the spectral moments in terms of their orthogonal norms. This includes exactly solvable models such as the elliptic Ginibre ensemble and non-Hermitian Wishart matrices.

arxiv-2509-19111.title: Robust Synchronous Reference Frame Phase-Looked Loop (PLL) with Feed-Forward Frequency Estimation
arxiv-2509-19111.creator: Michael Ruderman, Elia Brescia, Paolo Roberto Massenio, Giuseppe Leonardo Cascella, David Naso
arxiv-2509-19111.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Michael Ruderman, Elia Brescia, Paolo Roberto Massenio, Giuseppe Leonardo Cascella, David Naso. Synchronous reference frame phase-looked loop (SRF-PLL) techniques are widely used for interfacing and control applications in the power systems and energy conversion at large. Since a PLL system synchronizes its output with an exogenous harmonic signal, often 3-phases voltage or current, the locking of the frequency and phase angle depends on the performance of the feedback loop with at least two integrator terms, and on the distortions of the measured input quantities.

pmc-11375337.title: Therapeutic targets in membranous nephropathy: plasma cells and complement
pmc-11375337.creator: Nicola M Tomas
pmc-11375337.description: Membranous nephropathy (MN) is an antibody-mediated autoimmune disease and the most common cause of nephrotic syndrome in adults. The discovery of phospholipase A2 receptor 1 (PLA2R1) as the first target antigen in patients with MN 15 years ago has led to a paradigm shift in the pathobiological understanding of this disease.

pmc-11652632.title: Hybrid bagging and boosting with SHAP based feature selection for enhanced predictive modeling in intrusion detection systems
pmc-11652632.creator: Usman Ahmed, Zheng Jiangbin, Ahmad Almogren, Muhammad Sadiq, Ateeq Ur Rehman, M T Sadiq, Jaeyoung Choi
pmc-11652632.description: The novelty and growing sophistication of cyber threats mean that high accuracy and interpretable machine learning models are needed more than ever before for Intrusion Detection and Prevention Systems. This study aims to solve this challenge by applying Explainable AI techniques, including Shapley Additive explanations feature selection, to improve model performance, robustness, and transparency.

pmc-12401592.title: Development and evaluation of deep learning models for detecting and classifying various bone tumours in full-field limb radiographs using automated object detection models
pmc-12401592.creator: Masashi Yamana, Ryoma Bise, Makoto Endo, Tomoya Matsunobu, Nokitaka Setsu, Nobuhiko Yokoyama, Yasuharu Nakashima, Seiichi Uchida
pmc-12401592.description: AimsWe aim to develop a fully automated deep-learning model to detect and classify benign/malignant bone tumours in full-field limb radiographs using an object detection model. The secondary aim is to identify differences in classification characteristics between the developed automated model, three orthopaedic oncologists, and three general orthopaedic surgeons.

pmc-12502253.title: Living with pain—a systematic review on patients’ subjective experiences
pmc-12502253.creator: Maria Christidis, Essam Ahmed Al-Moraissi, Tasnim Miah, Laura Mihasi, Artin Razavian, Nikolaos Christidis, Giancarlo De la Torre Canales
pmc-12502253.description: BackgroundUnderstanding the subjective experiences of patients living with chronic, acute, and cancer pain can significantly enhance the selection of treatment approaches, care, and support, ultimately improving their quality of life. This qualitative systematic review aimed to analyze if the patients’ subjective experiences of living with pain differ between acute, chronic, and cancer pain states.

pmc-12649882.title: Effects of Clobetasol in an Aging Mouse Model of Spinal Cord Hemisection
pmc-12649882.creator: Maria Ciuro, Maria Sangiorgio, Giuliano Cantone, Carlo Fichera, Valeria Cacciato, Giampiero Leanza, Rosario Gulino
pmc-12649882.description: Simple SummarySpinal cord injury causes permanent damage to the nerves that control sensory and motor functions, leaving people with severe disability. Recovery after such an injury is very limited, and this problem becomes even worse with aging, when the brain and spinal cord lose much of their ability to repair themselves.

pmc-12667554.title: GDF15 Ameliorates Deoxynivalenol‐Induced Anemia by Resolving Ribosomal Stress–Mediated Erythropoietic Arrest
pmc-12667554.creator: Yan Li, Peijun Jia, Jingxin Zhang, Huan Zhang, Bing Li, Jiawei Chang, Yating Li, Longzhen Zhao, Yazhe Zhen, Tingting Zheng, Yuanlin Xu, Xiuli An, Shijie Zhang
pmc-12667554.description: Deoxynivalenol (DON) is a prevalent trichothecene mycotoxin that contaminates global food supplies, posing significant health risks; however, targeted therapies against DON are scarce. Although DON‐induced anemia is well‐documented, the underlying mechanisms remain unclear. In this study, the effects of DON on erythropoiesis are examined in detail using complementary murine models and human primary erythroid cultures.

pmc-12751769.title: Nomogram for survival prediction in metastatic differentiated thyroid cancer and survival comparison between systemic chemotherapy and local radiotherapy in high-risk patients
pmc-12751769.creator: Jian Xu
pmc-12751769.description: BackgroundDistant metastases are the leading cause of death for patients with differentiated thyroid cancer (DTC), and surgery and radioactive iodine (RAI) therapy are effective treatments for them. However, there remains a large proportion of patients with poor prognoses, and there exists no consensus on whether systemic chemotherapy or beam radiation should be administrated to improve their prognoses.

pmc-12978182.title: Unravelling the role of the gut microbiome in antipsychotic-induced weight gain and metabolic dysfunction in humans and rodents: A systematic review
pmc-12978182.creator: Maximilian Tufvesson-Alm, Louise Walsh, Sinead Pierce, Finola Keohane, Gerard Clarke, Karen O’Connor, John F Cryan, Harriet Schellekens
pmc-12978182.description: Second-generation antipsychotics are frequently linked to weight gain and metabolic dysfunction, yet the mechanisms driving these effects remain elusive. The gut microbiome has been proposed as a potential mediator of these adverse outcomes. This study aimed to investigate the role of the gut microbiota in antipsychotic-induced weight gain. A systematic search of PubMed and Embase was conducted.

pmc-13025520.title: A Simplified CAMBRA-Based Diagnostic Caries Risk Assessment Tool for Young Adults: Development and Clinical Validation
pmc-13025520.creator: Liana Beresescu, Alexandra Mihaela Stoica, Andrea Bors, Alina Ormenisan, Gabriela Felicia Beresescu, Andreea Lucaciu, Elena Stepco, Csilla Benedek
pmc-13025520.description: Background/Objectives: Young adulthood is a transitional period associated with changes in lifestyle and preventive dental attendance, which may influence caries risk. In routine practice, the use of comprehensive caries risk assessment systems is often limited by time and diagnostic requirements, highlighting the need for simplified diagnostic screening tools.

pmc-13243276.title: The impact of magnesium sulfate administration on outcomes in ICU patients with acute myocardial infarction: a retrospective cohort study
pmc-13243276.creator: Guibao Jiang, Gangzhi Zhuang, Hui Zhao, Rui Su, Xin Niu, Liqiong Wang, Jiayu Wu, Jia Liu, Jianchuan Zhang, Wengui Li, Qilin Yang, Rong Ding
pmc-13243276.description: BackgroundAlthough magnesium acts as a natural calcium antagonist with theoretical cardioprotective effects, its clinical value in critically ill patients with acute myocardial infarction (AMI) remains controversial. This study aimed to evaluate the impact of intravenous magnesium sulfate on ICU mortality in this population, and to explore potential dose-response relationships and effect modifiers.

pmc-13338013.title: The application of deep learning in tactical analysis of football matches
pmc-13338013.creator: Wuyu Huang, Sihang Wang, Pei Li
pmc-13338013.description: This paper presents a deep learning-based framework for tactical analysis in football, focusing on modeling structured tracking data rather than attempting full end-to-end perception. We introduce two modular components: Tactiformer, a transformer-based encoder that captures spatiotemporal player dynamics with role- and zone-aware attention, and StratGaze, a segment-level reasoning module that identifies recurring tactical motifs using contrastive sequence modeling.

pmc-13459358.title: ZNF662 inhibits oncogenesis through NUPR1/p53 signaling pathway in epithelial ovarian cancer and is regulated by hsa-miR-429
pmc-13459358.creator: Zhen Huang, Hongxue Fu, Ling Li, Wenjing Liao, Jing Zhang, Qin Tang, Mao Huang, Tingxiu Xiang, Liangdan Tang
pmc-13459358.description: BackgroundEpithelial ovarian cancer (EOC) represents the most lethal malignancy of the female reproductive system, though its etiology and pathogenesis remain incompletely characterized. The Krüppel-associated box domain zinc finger protein (KRAB-ZNF) family, the largest transcription factor family in mammals, plays critical roles in malignant tumor development and progression.
